summary.zh: 用围合空间和指定设施，把普通地块变成有功能的房间。
summary.en: Turn enclosed space and required fixtures into a functional room.

rules.zh: 玩家围出空间、设置入口并放置设施。系统按面积、封闭状态和内容判定用途或资格；不达标时无法获得预期功能。
rules.en: Players enclose space, add access and furnish it. Area, enclosure and contents determine room roles or eligibility; failed requirements block intended functions.

decisions.zh: 紧凑布局便宜，却挤压后续扩容。
decisions.en: Compact rooms are cheap but constrain expansion.

decisions.zh: 合用房间省空间，但可能改变识别用途。
decisions.en: Shared spaces save area but may alter the recognized role.

effect.zh: 显示缺失条件可减少盲目拆改。
effect.en: Showing missing requirements reduces blind rebuilding.

effect.zh: 二元达标容易理解，多级品质提供持续优化目标。
effect.en: Binary eligibility is readable; quality tiers provide ongoing goals.

contrast.zh: Terraria重在能否入住；RimWorld还把用途和品质纳入居民反馈。
contrast.en: Terraria emphasizes eligibility; RimWorld also considers role and quality.

combination.zh: 开一家旅馆，每位客人的要求不同，玩家在固定建筑内重新分隔和布置家具。
combination.en: Run an inn with different guest requirements, rearranging walls and furniture in a fixed building.

setup.zh: 你造了卧室，床和灯都有，却因为墙上缺一格而不被识别。
setup.en: Your bedroom has a bed and lamp but fails recognition because one wall cell is missing.

action.zh: 你查看缺失条件，补上墙并保留合法入口。
action.en: Inspect the unmet conditions, close the gap and keep a valid entrance.

result.zh: 房间状态从“不合格”变为“可用”，相关功能开始生效。
result.en: The room changes from invalid to usable and its function becomes available.

next.zh: 扩建房间或移动家具后，再确认资格有没有改变。
next.en: Recheck qualification after expanding or rearranging furniture.

firstStep.zh: 做封闭区域识别、一个入口和两件必需家具，逐条显示达标条件。
firstStep.en: Detect enclosed areas with an entrance and two required furniture items, displaying each condition separately.

pitfall.zh: 房间用途冲突、嵌套空间与多层识别会增加边界情况，先限定一个简单平面。
pitfall.en: Conflicting uses, nested spaces and multiple floors add edge cases; begin on one simple floor.

test.zh: 给一个只缺一项条件的房间，玩家能否凭提示修好，并理解原因？
test.en: Given a room missing one condition, can players fix it using the feedback and explain why?
